ov: A small striped minnow from fresh water in South Asia, sold as the zebra danio and widely used in lab research. Its eggs turn see-through almost at once, so scientists can watch it develop, and it is known for regrowing damaged tissue, including heart tissue.

why.p: Hardy, cheap and widely available, and considered good for beginner aquarists.

len: Up to 4–5 cm; usually 1.8–3.7 cm in the wild
rg: India, Pakistan, Bangladesh, Nepal and Bhutan, mainly the Ganges and Brahmaputra basins; introduced in parts of the US.
fx: It was the first fish sold as GloFish, genetically modified to glow green, red or yellow.
Adults live in shoals, and young fish start to prefer company at about 3 weeks old.
